trust_decision.summary: MISMAPPED: the listed fix commit does not touch redirects. It only adds a docblock to the installer's isAlreadyInstalled() and changes one template line. The advisory's decision (which admin-configured redirect targets may be followed) is made in Redirect Service::validateTarget at write time and Controller isTargetAllowed at read time, and both already exist at the pinned commit.

landing_point.why: The summary names admin-configured redirect targets. do_redirect passes the stored target to redirectUrl, which is where an engineer would look first.

fix_sites.entry_point: public installer page (install/install.php); docblock change only, no logic change

O3_reason_to_dismiss: unknown: the published fix contains no redirect change, so no fix scope can be compared against

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Relative targets ('/new-page', 'new-page') and absolute http/https external targets are tested as legitimate. A same-host-only fix would break the external ones.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The read-time check only allow-lists the scheme. It does not reject protocol-relative or backslash forms ('//host', '/\host'), which parse_url reports with no scheme.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer who reasons that a missing scheme means a relative path would write exactly this check. It is a parser-differential (how-type) gap, but it is our own construction and not the published fix.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: redirectUrl is a generic helper with no validation, so any new caller would need its own check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The helper is public and takes a raw URL

services: MySQL/MariaDB for full app; Redirect Service unit tests use mocks

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Restrict redirect targets to same-host or relative URLs, which breaks the legitimate external http/https redirects

out_of_scope_notes: The fix commit (#3636, 'Harden installer config presence checks') concerns the installer config check (a different weakness) and has no CWE-601 content.

The installer logic it documents (isAlreadyInstalled = !debug && file exists) is already at the pinned commit (src/install/install.php:352), and the 'invalid config means installed' test already exists (tests-legacy/library/FOSSBilling/FOSSBilling_ConfigTest.php:87).
unverified: The real fix commit for CVE-2026-43924 could not be found without git or network. The Redirect hardening at src/modules/Redirect/Service.php:149-163 and src/modules/Redirect/Controller/Client.php:62-74 may be that fix, already merged before the pinned commit.
Whether the advisory's intended property is scheme-only or same-host is unknown, so it is also unknown whether protocol-relative targets count as in scope.

O12: the only test the fix diff adds (testInstallerTreatsThrowingConfigAsAlreadyInstalled) is NOT present at the pinned commit, but it is unrelated to the advisory. The Redirect regression tests (tests-legacy/modules/Redirect/ServiceTest.php) already exist at the pinned commit, so the protection appears to be pre-fixed. Not flagged because the formal definition compares against the fix diff's tests.
